FILE eval/admission/artifact_admission.py SHA256 82279c1b789fd85038fc834d441da5436a726bc6766a4645c1a93d2a9540497d
  144 def load_contract(raw: bytes, expected_sha256: str) -> dict:
  145     """Accept only a caller-pinned declaration; no truth-valued attestation fields."""
  146     contract = _load_sealed_object(raw, expected_sha256, label="artifact contract")
  147     try:
  148         if (set(contract) != {"schema", "task_id", "source_sha256", "runtime_image_id",
  149                               "scorer", "export", "quota"}
  150                 or contract["schema"] != "harnessgrad.artifact-scorer.v1"
  151                 or not isinstance(contract["task_id"], str)
  152                 or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*", contract["task_id"])
  153                 or not _digest(contract["source_sha256"])
  154                 or not re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}", contract["runtime_image_id"])):
  155             raise AdmissionError("invalid artifact contract identity")
  156         validate_scorer_spec(contract["scorer"])
  157         export = contract["export"]
  158         if (set(export) != {"files", "max_bytes", "max_inodes"}
  159                 or not export["files"] or not _positive(export["max_bytes"])
  160                 or not _positive(export["max_inodes"])):
  161             raise AdmissionError("bounded state export required")
  162         for row in export["files"]:
  163             if set(row) != {"path", "max_bytes"} or not _positive(row["max_bytes"]):
  164                 raise AdmissionError("invalid state export file bound")
  165         _paths(export["files"])
  166         if _inodes([row["path"] for row in export["files"]]) > export["max_inodes"]:
  167             raise AdmissionError("state export inode quota exceeded")
  168         quota = contract["quota"]
  169         # Supported runtime writes are bounded tmpfs scratch/output only. Disk-backed
  170         # writable actor layers or project quotas require a separate real backend.
  171         if not quota or set(quota) - {"/tmp", "/control-output"}:
  172             raise AdmissionError("unsupported writable runtime quota surface")
  173         for limits in quota.values():
  174             if (set(limits) != {"bytes", "inodes"}
  175                     or not all(_positive(v) for v in limits.values())):
  176                 raise AdmissionError("hard byte and inode limits required")
  177         return contract
  182 @contextlib.contextmanager
  183 def _regular(root: Path, relative: str, *, data_only: bool = False):
  184     """Traverse using directory descriptors; never follow a link in any component."""
  185     relative = _relative(relative)
  186     _root(root)
  187     with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
  188         fd = os.open(root, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
  189         stack.callback(os.close, fd)
  190         for component in relative.split("/")[:-1]:
  191             fd = os.open(component, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
  192             stack.callback(os.close, fd)
  193         fd = os.open(relative.split("/")[-1], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK,
  194                      dir_fd=fd)
  195         stream = stack.enter_context(os.fdopen(fd, "rb"))
  196         info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
  197         if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1
  198                 or (data_only and info.st_mode & 0o111)):
  199             raise AdmissionError("state/closure must be regular files with one link; state must be data-only")
  200         yield stream, info
  201         # Reads can update atime; compare write-relevant fields only.
  202         after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
  203         if any(getattr(after, key) != getattr(info, key) for key in
  204                ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns", "st_nlink")):
  205             raise AdmissionError("source changed during projection")
  326 def export_state(source: Path, destination: Path, raw: bytes, expected_sha256: str,
  327                  *, run_id: str, execution_binding: dict | None = None) -> dict:
  328     """Copy an explicit data allowlist, with byte/inode limits enforced before writes.
  329 
  330     Source must be quiesced by the caller. The exclusive destination and its parent
  331     must be platform-owned; its files cannot supply a grader toolchain. Unselected
  332     actor files are never traversed. No old destination is reused or overwritten.
  333     Metadata checks detect observable source changes; they cannot establish quiescence.
  334     The platform primary group grants the separate scorer UID read/search access;
  335     host custody still rests on the exclusive platform-owned parent and RO mounts.
  336     """
  337     contract = load_contract(raw, expected_sha256)
  338     binding = _execution_binding(execution_binding, contract["task_id"]) if execution_binding is not None else None
  339     if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*", run_id):
  340         raise AdmissionError("fresh export run identity required")
  341     export = contract["export"]
  342     created = False
  343     try:
  344         _root(destination)
  345         source_path, destination_path = source.resolve(), destination.resolve()
  346         if (source_path == destination_path or source_path in destination_path.parents
  347                 or destination_path in source_path.parents):
  348             raise AdmissionError("state source and platform projection must be separate")
  349         destination.mkdir(mode=0o700)
  350         created = True
  351         os.chown(destination, -1, os.getegid())
  352         destination.chmod(0o750)
  353         total, records = 0, []
  354         for row in export["files"]:
  355             with _regular(source, row["path"], data_only=True) as (stream, info):
  356                 limit = min(row["max_bytes"], export["max_bytes"] - total)
  357                 if info.st_size > limit:
  358                     raise AdmissionError("state export byte quota exceeded")
  359                 target = destination / row["path"]
  360                 # Create each directory explicitly: parents=True does not apply
  361                 # the requested mode to intermediate parents, and umask may mask it.
  362                 parent = destination
  363                 for part in PurePosixPath(row["path"]).parts[:-1]:
  364                     parent = parent / part
  365                     if not parent.exists():
  366                         parent.mkdir(mode=0o700)
  367                         os.chown(parent, -1, os.getegid())
  368                         parent.chmod(0o750)
  369                 digest, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
  370                 with target.open("xb") as output:
  371                     os.chown(target, -1, os.getegid())
  372                     os.chmod(target, 0o640)
  373                     while True:
  374                         chunk = stream.read(min(65536, limit - size + 1))
  375                         if not chunk:
  376                             break
  377                         if size + len(chunk) > limit:
  378                             raise AdmissionError("state export byte quota exceeded")
  379                         output.write(chunk)
  380                         digest.update(chunk)
  381                         size += len(chunk)
  382                 if size != info.st_size:
  383                     raise AdmissionError("source size changed during projection")
  384                 total += size
  385                 records.append(dict(path=row["path"], bytes=size, sha256=digest.hexdigest()))
  386         return dict(schema="harnessgrad.state-export-receipt.v2" if binding is not None
  387                     else "harnessgrad.state-export-receipt.v1", run_id=run_id,
  388                     task_id=contract["task_id"], contract_sha256=expected_sha256,
  389                     source_sha256=contract["source_sha256"], files=records,
  390                     bytes=total, inodes=_inodes([row["path"] for row in records]),
  391                     limits={key: export[key] for key in ("max_bytes", "max_inodes")},
  392                     scope="local_artifact_projection",
  393                     **({"execution_binding": binding} if binding is not None else {}))
  394     except (OSError, AdmissionError) as exc:
  395         if created:
  396             try:
  397                 shutil.rmtree(destination)
  398             except OSError as cleanup:
  399                 raise EvidenceUnavailable("failed state export cleanup; partial projection retained") from cleanup
  400         if isinstance(exc, AdmissionError):
  401             raise
  402         raise EvidenceUnavailable("state export unavailable; existing destination is never reused") from exc
  403

  405 def verify_state_export(root: Path, receipt: dict, raw: bytes, expected_sha256: str,
  406                         *, run_id: str, execution_binding: dict | None = None) -> None:
  407     """Recheck a platform export receipt immediately before a read-only mount."""
  408     contract = load_contract(raw, expected_sha256)
  409     binding = _execution_binding(execution_binding, contract["task_id"]) if execution_binding is not None else None
  410     try:
  411         export = contract["export"]
  412         schema = "harnessgrad.state-export-receipt.v2" if binding is not None else "harnessgrad.state-export-receipt.v1"
  413         if (receipt["schema"] != schema or receipt.get("execution_binding") != binding
  414                 or receipt["scope"] != "local_artifact_projection"
  415                 or receipt["run_id"] != run_id or receipt["task_id"] != contract["task_id"]
  416                 or receipt["contract_sha256"] != expected_sha256
  417                 or receipt["source_sha256"] != contract["source_sha256"]
  418                 or receipt["limits"] != {key: export[key] for key in ("max_bytes", "max_inodes")}
  419                 or [row["path"] for row in receipt["files"]] != [row["path"] for row in export["files"]]):
  420             raise AdmissionError("state export receipt identity mismatch")
  421         names = {row["path"] for row in export["files"]}
  422         expected = names | {str(p) for name in names for p in PurePosixPath(name).parents if str(p) != "."}
  423         if _inventory(root) != expected:
  424             raise AdmissionError("state projection differs from data allowlist")
  425         total = 0
  426         for row, bound in zip(receipt["files"], export["files"]):
  427             if (type(row["bytes"]) is not int or not 0 <= row["bytes"] <= bound["max_bytes"]
  428                     or not _digest(row["sha256"])):
  429                 raise AdmissionError("invalid state export seal")
  430             total += row["bytes"]
  431             if total > export["max_bytes"]:
  432                 raise AdmissionError("state export byte quota exceeded")
  433             with _regular(root, row["path"], data_only=True) as (stream, info):
  434                 if info.st_size != row["bytes"]:
  435                     raise AdmissionError("state projection size mismatch")
  436                 digest, remaining = hashlib.sha256(), info.st_size
  437                 while remaining:
  438                     chunk = stream.read(min(65536, remaining))
  439                     if not chunk:
  440                         raise AdmissionError("state projection truncated")
  441                     digest.update(chunk)
  442                     remaining -= len(chunk)
  443                 if stream.read(1) or digest.hexdigest() != row["sha256"]:
  444                     raise AdmissionError("state projection seal mismatch")
  445         if receipt["bytes"] != total or receipt["inodes"] != _inodes(names):
  446             raise AdmissionError("state export accounting mismatch")

FILE data/scaffolds/qa/prediction.py SHA256 598ebb5fe688f561d6cb6388ef202be4233de14058c51e65391613c7a6bedd7e
    1 """Validation for the optional structured QA prediction artifact.
    2 
    3 The artifact is deliberately small and closed: a schema version, a final answer, and
    4 optional model-selected evidence. Gold answers and arbitrary metadata never belong in it.
    5 """
    6 from __future__ import annotations
    7 
    8 SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
    9 ALLOWED_KEYS = {"schema_version", "answer", "predicted_evidence"}
   10 
   11 
   12 def validate_prediction(value: object) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
   13     if not isinstance(value, dict):
   14         return None, "prediction must be a JSON object"
   15     if set(value) - ALLOWED_KEYS:
   16         return None, "prediction contains unsupported properties"
   17     if value.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
   18         return None, f"schema_version must be {SCHEMA_VERSION}"
   19     answer = value.get("answer")
   20     if not isinstance(answer, str) or not answer.strip():
   21         return None, "answer must be a nonempty string"
   22     evidence = value.get("predicted_evidence")
   23     if evidence is None:
   24         return dict(value), None
   25     if not isinstance(evidence, list):
   26         return None, "predicted_evidence must be a list of pairs"
   27     for index, pair in enumerate(evidence):
   28         if (not isinstance(pair, list) or len(pair) != 2
   29                 or not isinstance(pair[0], str) or not pair[0].strip()
   30                 or isinstance(pair[1], bool) or not isinstance(pair[1], int)
   31                 or pair[1] < 0):
   32             return None, (
   33                 f"predicted_evidence[{index}] must be [nonempty page/title, "
   34                 "nonnegative integer]")
   35     return dict(value), None
   36 
   37 
   38 __all__ = ["SCHEMA_VERSION", "validate_prediction"]
FILE data/datasets/twowikimultihopqa.py SHA256 55556cbb914e64bcdb644b5d96df6b89752a927c3b96a4b5d34f3dbbc3ceec21
  411                      "id": gold.get("id"), "type": gold.get("type")},
  412         "why": (f"legacy answer-only: Ans F1={metrics['f1']:g}, Ans EM={metrics['em']:g}; "
  413                 "Sup/Evi/Joint are not reported in this mode"),
  414     }
  415 
  416 
  417 METRIC_KEYS = tuple(prefix + metric for prefix in ("", "sp_", "evi_", "joint_")
  418                     for metric in ("em", "f1", "prec", "recall"))
  419 PREDICTION_KEYS = {"schema_version", "answer", "supporting_facts", "evidence"}
  420 
  421 
  422 def validate_prediction(prediction: dict) -> None:
  423     """Validate the adapter's public JSON contract, including partial predictions.
  424 
  425     Omitted channels are different from submitted empty values. Unknown fields and
  426     malformed channels are contract errors rather than invented scorer zeroes.
  427     """
  428     if not isinstance(prediction, dict) or set(prediction) - PREDICTION_KEYS:
  429         raise ValueError("2Wiki prediction must be an object with only public prediction fields")
  430     if type(prediction.get("schema_version")) is not int or prediction["schema_version"] != 1:
  431         raise ValueError("2Wiki prediction requires schema_version=1")
  432     if "answer" in prediction and not isinstance(prediction["answer"], str):
  433         raise ValueError("answer must be a string")
  434     for channel, length in (("supporting_facts", 2), ("evidence", 3)):
  435         if channel not in prediction:
  436             continue
  437         if not isinstance(prediction[channel], list):
  438             raise ValueError(f"{channel} must be a list")
  439         for item in prediction[channel]:
  440             if not isinstance(item, list) or len(item) != length:
  441                 raise ValueError(f"{channel} entries must be lists of length {length}")
  442             if channel == "supporting_facts":
  443                 valid = (isinstance(item[0], str) and type(item[1]) is int and item[1] >= 0)
  444             else:
  445                 valid = all(isinstance(part, str) for part in item)
  446             if not valid:
  447                 raise ValueError(f"invalid {channel} entry")
  448 
  449 
  450 def _prediction_metrics(prediction: dict, gold: dict) -> dict:
  451     validate_prediction(prediction)
  452     if not isinstance(gold.get("answer"), str):
  453         raise ValueError("gold has no answer")
  454     if "supporting_facts" not in gold or "evidences" not in gold:
  455         raise ValueError("structured scoring requires support and evidence gold")
  456     metrics = dict.fromkeys(METRIC_KEYS, 0.0)
  457     if "answer" in prediction:
  458         em, prec, recall = update_answer(
  459             metrics, prediction["answer"], {gold["answer"], *gold.get("aliases", [])})
  460     if "supporting_facts" in prediction:
  461         sp_em, sp_prec, sp_recall = update_sp(
  462             metrics, prediction["supporting_facts"], gold["supporting_facts"])
  463     if "evidence" in prediction:
  464         variants = _evidence_variants(gold)
  465         # Upstream normalizes evidence in place; variants are fresh and predictions
  466         # must be copied so a verifier does not mutate its inputs.
  467         evi_em, evi_prec, evi_recall = update_evi(
  468             metrics, deepcopy(prediction["evidence"]), variants)
  469     if all(channel in prediction for channel in ("answer", "supporting_facts", "evidence")):
  470         joint_prec = prec * sp_prec * evi_prec
  471         joint_recall = recall * sp_recall * evi_recall
  472         metrics.update(
  473             joint_em=float(em * sp_em * evi_em), joint_prec=joint_prec,
  474             joint_recall=joint_recall,
  475             joint_f1=(2 * joint_prec * joint_recall / (joint_prec + joint_recall)
  476                       if joint_prec + joint_recall > 0 else 0.0))
  477     return metrics
  478 
  479 
  480 def score_prediction(prediction: dict, gold: dict) -> dict:
  481     """All official v1.1 metrics; Joint F1 reward and Joint EM correctness."""
  482     metrics = _prediction_metrics(prediction, gold)
  483     return {"reward": float(metrics["joint_f1"]), "correct": bool(metrics["joint_em"]),
  484             "official": {"metric": "2WikiMultihopQA Joint F1 (official v1.1 evaluator)",
  485                          "mode": "structured", "scale": "fraction", **metrics,
  486                          "id": gold.get("id"), "type": gold.get("type")},
  487             "why": f"Joint F1={metrics['joint_f1']:g}, Joint EM={metrics['joint_em']:g}"}
  488 
  489 
  490 def score(prediction: str | dict, gold: dict) -> dict:
  491     """Platform entry point: JSON in answer.txt, or labeled legacy answer text."""
  492     if isinstance(prediction, dict):
  493         return score_prediction(prediction, gold)
  494     if prediction.lstrip().startswith("{"):
  495         return score_prediction(json.loads(prediction), gold)
  496     return score_answer_only(prediction, gold)

  110     except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - a check that cannot run is not a zero
  111         evidence.update(measured=False, error=f"could not start the game: {exc}",
  112                         traceback=traceback.format_exc()[-2000:])
  113         write_evidence(args.evidence_file, evidence)
  114         print(f"check cannot measure: {evidence['error']}", file=sys.stderr)
  115         return 3
  116 
  117     try:
  118         maximum = int(env.get_max_score())
  119         spec = json.loads(args.game.read_text())
  120         steps = jer_env.replay(env, actions)
  121     except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
  122         evidence.update(measured=False, error=f"the game died mid-episode: {exc}",
  123                         traceback=traceback.format_exc()[-2000:])
  124         write_evidence(args.evidence_file, evidence)
  125         print(f"check cannot measure: {evidence['error']}", file=sys.stderr)
  126         return 3
  127 
  128     score = steps[-1]["score"] if steps else 0
  129     moves = steps[-1]["moves"] if steps else 0
  130     fraction = jer_env.score_fraction(score, maximum)
  131     evidence.update(
  132         measured=True,
  133         reward=fraction,
  134         score=score,
  135         max_score=maximum,

  115 def hash_of(value) -> str:
  116     from tau_bench.envs.hash import consistent_hash, to_hashable
  117     return consistent_hash(to_hashable(value))
  118 
  184 def check_outputs(outputs, says) -> tuple[dict, float]:
  185     """`tau_bench/envs/base.py:calculate_reward`'s outputs rule, applied to `says`.
  186 
  187     Verbatim upstream test, per output: `output.lower()` must appear in some
  188     respond content after `content.lower().replace(",", "")`. Note the comma
  189     removal applies to the content only, exactly as upstream wrote it. Returns
  190     `(found_by_output, r_outputs)`, mirroring upstream's `RewardOutputInfo`.
  191     """
  192     found = {}
  193     for output in outputs:
  194         found[output] = any(
  195             str(output).lower() in str(say).lower().replace(",", "")
  196             for say in says)
  197     return found, (1.0 if all(found.values()) else 0.0)
  198 
  199 
  200 def section_comparison(agent_db, gt_db) -> dict:
  284     # ---- the agent's own log: evidence, and the `done`/`outputs` gates. ----
  285     log = read_agent_log(paths["call_log"])
  286     evidence.update(log)
  287     outputs_found, r_outputs = check_outputs(outputs, log["agent_says"])
  288     done = log["agent_declared_done"]
  289     evidence.update(outputs=outputs_found, r_outputs=r_outputs,
  290                     outputs_satisfied=(r_outputs == 1.0))
  291 
  292     # ---- the agent's database, which is the state being graded ----
  293     try:
  294         raw = paths["db"].read_bytes()
  295         agent_db = json.loads(raw)
  296         if not isinstance(agent_db, dict):
  297             raise ValueError(f"database is a {type(agent_db).__name__}, "
  298                              f"expected a JSON object")
  299     except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
  300         evidence.update(reward=0, database_hash_matched=False,
  301                         agent_db_error=str(exc), agent_db_keys=[])
  302         write_reward(paths["reward"], 0)
  303         write_evidence(paths["evidence"], evidence)
  304         print(f"reward 0: the agent's database could not be read: {exc}")
  305         return 0
  306 
  307     agent_hash = hash_of(agent_db)
  308     matched = agent_hash == gt_hash
  309     reward = int(matched and done and r_outputs == 1.0)
  310     evidence.update(reward=reward, database_hash_matched=matched,
  311                     agent_data_hash=agent_hash, agent_db_bytes=len(raw),
  312                     agent_db_keys=sorted(agent_db),
  313                     sections=section_comparison(agent_db, clean_db))
  314 
  315     write_reward(paths["reward"], reward)
